`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_msb256
    wire [15:0] group_valid;
    wire [15:0] group_winner;
    wire [15:0] local_winner [0:15];
    wire [3:0] local_code [0:15];
    wire [15:0] low_terms [0:3];
    wire empty;

    genvar g, j, b;
    for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
        assign group_valid[g] = |input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
        if (g == 15) begin : top_group
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g];
        end else begin : other_group
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
        end

        for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : bits_in_group
            if (j == 15) begin : top_bit
                assign local_winner[g][j] = input_unencoded[g*16+j];
            end else begin : other_bit
                assign local_winner[g][j] = input_unencoded[g*16+j]
                    & ~(|input_unencoded[g*16+15:g*16+j+1]);
            end
            if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : default_bit
                assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] =
                    (local_winner[g][j] & group_winner[g]) | empty;
            end else begin : ordinary_bit
                assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] =
                    local_winner[g][j] & group_winner[g];
            end
        end

        assign local_code[g][0] = |(local_winner[g] & 16'hAAAA);
        assign local_code[g][1] = |(local_winner[g] & 16'hCCCC);
        assign local_code[g][2] = |(local_winner[g] & 16'hF0F0);
        assign local_code[g][3] = |(local_winner[g] & 16'hFF00);
        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : masked_codes
            assign low_terms[b][g] = local_code[g][b] & group_winner[g];
        end
    end

    assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    assign empty = ~output_valid;
    for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : low_code
        assign output_encoded[b] = |low_terms[b];
    end
    assign output_encoded[4] = |(group_winner & 16'hAAAA);
    assign output_encoded[5] = |(group_winner & 16'hCCCC);
    assign output_encoded[6] = |(group_winner & 16'hF0F0);
    assign output_encoded[7] = |(group_winner & 16'hFF00);
end else begin : original_parameters
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
    genvar l, n;
    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_priority_mode
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : high_priority_mode
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_priority_mode
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : high_priority_mode
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original implementation propagates encoded bits through successive priority-controlled mux levels, then decodes the final eight-bit index into 256 output bits. That serial encode/decode path is a likely maximum-arrival bottleneck.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the requested instance into sixteen parallel 16-bit priority groups. Compute local winners and group winners using suffix reductions, generate the one-hot output directly, and form the encoded output using masked OR reductions. Retain the original implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by removing the serial index-to-one-hot decode and replacing much of the mux depth with parallel reductions. No mapped timing measurements are available; a numerical gain or optimality claim is not justified.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds parallel winner-mask and local-code logic while removing the 256-way index decoder. Actual mapped area, timing, and electrical compliance must be checked with the specified flow; compliance with the 8862.124480 um^2 cap has not been measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For the fixed instance, the highest asserted input bit wins. For an all-zero input, output_valid is zero, output_encoded is zero, and output_unencoded is 256'b1, preserving the original default behavior. Ports, parameter defaults, exposed LEVELS and W parameters, widths, and combinational operation are retained. The specialization applies only to WIDTH=256, LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, LEVELS=8, W=256; other configurations use the original expressions and truncations. No storage, assumptions, or external dependencies are introduced. Mapped equivalence has not been run."
}
